_comment: Per-alias outcome memory (owner 2026-11-08 01:45 UTC, part C): demo rows that are NEVER counted against a configuration. First match wins. A rule's 'match' compares a memory row's fields (status, rc, reason, failure_type, stage, action, alias, tag, snapshot = ctx.snapshot, meta / sidecar = file present, wall_clock_exceeded): a scalar = equal, a list = one of, {"not_in": [...]}, {"re": regex}. 'kind' infrastructure = not the configuration's doing; known_bug = a documented defect of the code, counted again once fixed (scope it by snapshot). Add a rule with its why and its DECISIONS line; never remove one silently.

exclusions.why: run_isg crashed (rc 4: an exception, not a verdict)
the collector exited with neither success (0) nor an oracle verdict (2)
the episode's wall clock / slurm deadline, not a planner or QA verdict
meta.wall_clock_exceeded: the episode was cut by time
no demo meta.json: the outcome or its stage is unknown
no sidecar: the configuration is unknown

the grasp's recorded IK solution is 77 / 576 mm from its target pose (i7_attswept 300115 / 300116): a sampler defect the owner ordered fixed (DECISIONS 2026-11-08 01:30 and 02:20 item 3, branch i7-attachfix) - not the configuration's doing; scoped to the snapshots before the fix
